front: Two nights to catch up on. Sunday's slate locked early, at 2:52pm, and your PM lock came at 3:12pm, after the first tip, so the record set it aside; with no drafts and no ETR file on time, there is nothing of yours to grade from Sunday, only the box scores (Towns 51.9 in 43 minutes, Barnes 55.8, Amen 47.9 on 9-11; Trae 0-5 and Acuff 9 turnovers in routs). Saturday you ran 10 teams in Saturday Slam off a 1:55pm Lock PM: median finish top 57%, none in the top 10%. Cleveland's news broke after that lock (Mitchell, Harden, Allen and Watson ruled out, then Michael Porter Jr. sat), so Cleveland and Brooklyn are left out of Saturday's afternoon grading. On what's left, your PM board was right on 43% of its splits with ETR's final order and 64% against our number; of the eight biggest calls, the Davion Mitchell and Aaron Gordon raises and the Duncan Robinson fade came good, the fades on Braun (5 stocks) and Queen, the Reed fade and the Wiggins raise didn't. The swap lock at 2:57pm came after the Cleveland news, which is what it's for. One pattern to carry to the 11/27 projection review: on Saturday our teammate-out bumps ran too high again (Matkovic, Stewart, GG Jackson, Missi), and on the season ETR has been closer on 13 of our 18 teammate-out splits.
back: Sunday slates can lock an hour early (2:52pm): a PM lock or ETR upload after the first tip isn't recorded. The fresh-absence bump (1.5x, from 11-14) is on watch: since it went in, ETR has been closer on 4 of the 5 teammate-out splits.
